13d6112f254d: Understand, Translate and Check — the three modes · translationCore 4 Help
22c05e04d926: Your place in the book stays the same when you switch, and Open Bible Stories projects have the same three modes.
61aee9109a1b: Open a book or story from Home.
128bfef94f36: Click Understand, Translate or Check in the middle of the top bar. The one you are in is filled in.
08d61dfdd7ca: Understand: read the passage with its notes, word links and questions, and write your own comments. See Read a passage before you translate.
79ebbb5807f3: Translate: draft your translation beside the source texts. See The Translate screen.
c0cac543b795: Check: check your draft with Translation Notes and Translation Words, align words, and preview the book. See Choose a checking tool.
29c21f035696: Many teams go in that order, but you can switch at any time.
20b3650806b8: A book or story you open for the first time starts in Understand. After that, tC4 opens it in the mode you used last.
7ae9ea51f3a9: Check goes back to the checking tool you used last. To pick another one, click ← All checking tools at the top left.
89c9737cc63f: Switching modes saves a checkpoint if anything changed. See Saving and checkpoints.
4ffefe6c913a: Exporting is not a separate mode. It is in Check › Community Checking. See Export a book as PDF.
20f0ff816d20: The switch in the middle of the top bar: Understand, Translate (selected, filled in light blue) and Check.
